jobs.title: Customer Success Manager Netherlands (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
About this role

As a Customer Success Manager at Eye Security, you’ll take full ownership of a diverse and strategic customer portfolio from day one. This is a role for someone who thrives on autonomy, loves building strong client partnerships, and knows how to drive long-term value. You’ll design and execute success strategies, guide customers through onboarding and adoption, and ensure they get maximum impact from our cybersecurity solutions.

You’ll work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales, and other teams, acting as the voice of the customer and a key driver of retention and growth. If you excel at turning insights into action and enjoy shaping the customer journey end to end, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

 - Lead and build relationships: Own a portfolio of customers and guide them with tailored strategies that increase adoption, satisfaction, and long-term retention.

 - Spot opportunities & drive growth: Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities by understanding customer needs and uncovering additional value.

 - Be the voice of the customer: Advocate for your customers internally and help influence product and service improvements through their feedback.

 - Collaborate for success: Work closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and other teams to deliver seamless, impactful customer experiences.

 - Use data to fuel decisions: Track customer health metrics and transform insights into actionable strategies that strengthen relationships and outcomes.

What You Bring

 - You have at least 5 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a similar customer-facing role, with a strong track record of driving satisfaction, retention, and growth.

 - You communicate clearly and confidently in both Dutch and English, and you’re comfortable presenting to senior stakeholders and leading customer conversations.

 - You’re highly analytical, able to turn data into actionable insights, and experienced with CRM systems such as HubSpot or Salesforce.

 - You bring a customer-obsessed mindset, always looking to understand their challenges and help them unlock long-term value.

 - You’re tech-savvy, and experience in SaaS, cybersecurity, or a similar environment is a strong plus.

What We Offer

 - A meaningful mission: protect organizations across Europe from real-world cyber threats.

 - A hybrid-friendly culture with regular company-wide get-togethers, giving you the opportunity to collaborate in person and build strong team connections.

 - Work with top-tier professionals from national CERTs, intelligence agencies, and leading tech backgrounds.

 - Full ownership of a strategic function in a high-growth cybersecurity scale-up.

 - Weekly lunches (NL) and Thursday socials to stay connected.

 - A generous time-off policy, including wellbeing and volunteering days.

Ready to take ownership, bring ideas to life, and inspire others? 
We’d love to hear from you. Apply now and become part of our mission at Eye Security.



About Eye Security

Eye Security provides cybersecurity and embedded cyber insurance solutions for organizations across Europe. Headquartered in the Netherlands, we’ve grown to over 170 employees and continue to expand internationally.

We combine cutting-edge technology with hands-on expertise to detect, respond to, and recover from cyber threats in real time. Our team unites professionals from intelligence, military, tech, and consulting backgrounds - all driven by one mission: to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to every business, not just the big players.

At Eye, you’ll work on international projects, solving real-world challenges and helping to build a safer digital future for our clients.

jobs.title: Partner Manager MSP - Norden (f/m/x)

Med ett starkt entreprenöriellt driv representerar du Eye på den nordiska marknaden och samarbetar tätt med kollegor inom sälj och marknad.

Vad du kommer att göra:

 - Bygga upp och expandera Eyes ekosystem av MSP-partners i Norden.

 - Identifiera och onboarda nya partners samt bygga långsiktiga, förtroendefulla relationer.

Din profil och bakgrund:

 - Starkt affärssinne och en proaktiv, driven säljmentalitet.

 - Bakgrund inom SaaS-försäljning. Kunskap inom cybersäkerhet är starkt meriterande.

 - Goda kunskaper i svenska eller danska samt engelska.

 - Flexibilitet och en beredskap att resa regelbundet (runt 30%) inom Norden.

Vad vi erbjuder

 - Möjligheten att bli en del av ett av Europas snabbast växande scale-ups inom cybersäkerhet.

 - En nyckelroll i att bygga upp ett innovativt produktutbud, där vi kombinerar effektiv cybersäkerhet med cyberförsäkring på global nivå.

Eye Security levererar cybersäkerhetslösningar med integrerad cyberförsäkring till organisationer runt om i Europa. Vi har vårt huvudkontor i Nederländerna, har redan passerat 170 heltidsanställda (FTEs) och fortsätter att växa internationellt.

Vi kombinerar spetsteknologi med praktisk erfarenhet och djup expertis för att upptäcka, hantera och avvärja cyberhot i realtid. I vårt team ingår talanger med bakgrund från underrättelsetjänsten, militären, techsektorn och konsultbranschen – alla med samma mål: att göra cybersäkerhet i världsklass tillgänglig för alla företag, inte bara de stora aktörerna!

Hos oss på Eye får du arbeta med projekt som har ett internationellt avtryck, lösa komplexa problem i verkligheten och bidra till att skapa en tryggare digital framtid för våra kunder.

jobs.title: HR Business partner
jobs.description:
People Business Partner

Most HRBP roles ask you to run processes someone else built. This one asks you to build them, inside the part of the business where cybersecurity actually happens, with managers who are still learning to lead and specialists who know exactly how rare they are. If you need a mature organization around you to do your best work, this isn't it. If you get energy from building one, keep reading.


The role
You'll be the People Business Partner for our core business: security operations, incident response, customer support & on boarding, and project management. It's the most varied population in the company: working students running shift rosters next to deeply specialized senior engineers, and managers at very different stages of their leadership journey. 

That mix is exactly why this role needs presence more than years. You'll coach first-time managers on the basics one hour and challenge C-level on a strategic call the next. You'll need to be comfortable doing both, and to enjoy it.

And here's what makes this role bigger than the title: alongside the partnering work, you'll get to build things most HRBPs only inherit: redesigning our performance cycle, rethinking benefits, shaping how development works here. You'll lead them yourself, start to finish, and see them land in the business you partner with every day.


What you'll do

 - Be the trusted partner for leaders in security operations and customer support: coaching, challenging, and advising at every level of maturity, up to and including the executive team.

 - Be visible. This is an office where face-to-face matters: you'll be on the floor in The Hague, listening to what's actually going on, not partnering from a distance.

 - Build and lead People projects end to end: think redesigning the performance cycle, refreshing benefits, or building a development approach from scratch, taking it from first idea to something that sticks, while your HRBP work keeps running.

 - Handle the real side of employee relations: complex cases, conduct issues, working with external counsel when needed. You've seen the ugly cases and you don't flinch.

 - Apply Dutch labor law hands-on in day-to-day decisions, and know when to bring in an expert.

 - Work as part of a small, tight People team: everyone picks things up, and so will you.




What we're looking for

 - HRBP experience in a scaling tech environment. You've lived the journey from around 50 to a few hundred people and know what good looks like at 200 to 400.

 - Strong stakeholder management and the presence to challenge back, including senior leadership, without becoming the policy police.

 - A track record of hands-on project leadership: you've owned People initiatives from design to rollout yourself, not coordinated them from the sidelines.

 - Genuinely comfortable with ambiguity: our problems don't come with a manual, and you'd rather solve them creatively than wait for one.

 - Hands-on, working knowledge of Dutch labor law.

 - Fluent Dutch (native not required) and professional English.

 - Based in the Netherlands and happy with coming to the office: minimum 1 day per week in The Hague, ideally 3.




What we offer

 - Real impact: help build the People foundations of a company protecting businesses across Europe, alongside colleagues from intelligence, military, tech and consulting backgrounds.

 - Thursday borrels and regular team socials to catch up in person.

 - Quarterly get-togethers and an annual company-wide retreat (Spain, Portugal, Italy…).

 - Generous time off, including well being days, floating holidays and a volunteering day.

 - Competitive base salary and company stock (ESOP).

 - MacBook Pro or Dell XPS, plus iPhone or Samsung



About Eye Security

Eye Security protects European mid-market businesses from cyber threats: 24/7 monitoring and response, incident response, and integrated cyber insurance, all in one. We're 170+ people across the Netherlands, UK, Germany and Belgium, with roots in Dutch intelligence and national CERTs. Our mission is simple: enterprise-grade security shouldn't only be for enterprises.

jobs.title: Senior Partner & Field Marketing Manager Nordics (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
About this role

We are seeking an ambitious Field Marketing Manager to establish and lead Eye Security's market presence in the Nordics region. This is our first marketing hire in a new market, giving you the unique opportunity to build marketing from the ground up in Stockholm, Sweden, and subsequently expand into Denmark and Norway.

In this role, you will own the strategic and operational foundation of marketing in the Nordics. You will develop go-to-market strategies, drive qualified pipeline, activate partner ecosystems, execute campaigns, and measure ROI. Reporting to the Head of Marketing Benelux & Nordics, you'll work independently and collaboratively with our central Marketing team, sales organization, partner network, and internal stakeholders to establish Eye Security as a trusted cybersecurity partner across the region.

What you will do

 - Build market strategy: Develop a field marketing and channel strategy tailored to the Nordics. Define messaging, positioning, and tactics specific to each market.

 - Plan and execute campaigns: Identify and develop marketing initiatives, including demand generation, brand awareness, partner co-marketing, and thought leadership, to drive qualified pipeline aligned with our Ideal Customer Profile.

 - Own the event lifecycle: Identify and select high-value industry events and conferences. Manage all aspects from concept through execution, lead capture, follow-up, and ROI measurement.

 - Localize content and messaging: Adapt Eye Security's global positioning, content, and campaigns for the Nordics market to resonate with local buyers and partners.

 - Activate and manage the partner ecosystem: Develop relationships with channel partners and support them with co-marketing assets, enablement resources, and campaign planning to drive pipeline together.

 - Lead and coordinate events: Represent Eye Security at industry events with commercial thinking and entrepreneurial drive. Host webinars, roundtables, and local workshops that build brand awareness and qualify leads.

 - Manage agencies and vendors: Brief, oversee, and collaborate with external agencies (PR, content, demand generation) to execute campaigns effectively and on budget.

 - Own the budget and reporting: Manage the Nordics marketing budget, track spend against plan, measure pipeline contribution, and report on marketing performance and ROI to leadership.

 - Collaborate across functions: Work closely with Product Marketing, Sales, and the central Marketing team to ensure aligned messaging, coordinated campaign execution, and maximum market impact.

What you will need

 - 5+ years of experience in B2B SaaS or IT marketing, with proven success in field marketing, partner marketing, or demand generation.

 - Commercial mindset: Think strategically about pipeline impact, conversion rates, and partner activation. Demonstrate experience translating marketing activities into measurable business results.

 - Go-to-market execution: Strong track record planning and launching campaigns, managing events end-to-end, and building partner programs from scratch.

 - Strategic thinking: Ability to develop market entry and expansion strategies, segment audiences, and allocate resources based on ICP and pipeline potential.

 - Self-starter mentality: Comfortable working independently in a new market with minimal existing structure, while staying aligned with central teams. You'll wear many hats and thrive in ambiguity.

 - Partnership mindset: Experience collaborating with channel partners, sales teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to achieve shared goals.

 - Language skills: Fluent in English and Swedish required.

 - Hands-on project management: Excellent organizational skills, ability to manage multiple campaigns and timelines simultaneously, and comfort with operational execution alongside strategy.

 - Marketing technology: Familiarity with HubSpot and marketing automation tools is a plus. Comfortable adopting and leveraging AI tools to work more efficiently.

 - Cultural fit: You thrive in a people-focused culture, communicate clearly, and bring entrepreneurial energy to building something new.

What we offer

 - Autonomy and impact: Build the Nordics marketing function from day one. Your work directly shapes market presence and revenue growth in a new region.

 - Career growth: Transition from market builder to regional leader as we expand. Opportunity to own a strategic part of Eye Security's European growth story.

 - Competitive compensation: Attractive salary and benefits package.

 - Collaboration: Work with a talented central Marketing team and sales organization committed to your success.

 - Company culture: Join a mission-driven company dedicated to protecting SMEs and building a human-centered security culture.

 - Flexibility: Work-life balance and flexible working arrangements.

About Eye Security

Eye Security is providing cybersecurity with embedded cyber insurance solutions for organizations in Europe. Headquartered in the Netherlands, we are already over 170 FTEs and continue to grow internationally.

We combine cutting-edge technology with hands-on expertise to detect, respond to, and recover from cyber threats in real time. Our team brings together talent from intelligence, military, tech, and consulting backgrounds, all united by a shared mission: to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to every business, not just the big players.

At Eye, you will work on projects with an international footprint, solving real-world challenges and helping to build a safer digital future for our clients.

Interview process

We evaluate candidates on commercial thinking, strategic mindset, execution excellence, and cultural fit. You can expect conversations with our Marketing Lead, Sales leadership, and the Leadership team.

To apply: Please submit your CV and a brief cover letter (one page) describing your experience building marketing in a new market or scaling from an early-stage marketing function.

Deine Aufgaben

 - Du baust unser Partner- und Eye-Vertriebsnetz von Grund auf auf – mit Fokus auf sicherheitsorientierte Partnerschaften.

 - Du gehst aktiv auf potenzielle Partner zu, überzeugst sie von einer Zusammenarbeit und entwickelst daraus ein tragfähiges Netzwerk.

 - Von der Vertragsgestaltung bis zum Geschäftsabschluss bist du die professionelle Unterstützung für unsere Partner

 - Du präsentierst unsere Lösungen auf Messen und Veranstaltungen

 - Eine enge und partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit mit deinen Kollegen (m/w/d) aus Vertrieb und Marketing sowie unseren Geschäftsbereichen ist für dich selbstverständlich und die Basis für unseren gemeinsamen Erfolg

 - Du konzipierst, vereinbarst und managst die Partner bei der Umsetzung des gemeinsamen Businessplans



Dein Profil

 - Nachweisbare Erfahrung im Aufbau eines Partnernetzwerks von Grund auf

 - Analytische Fähigkeiten und eine solide strategische Planungsfähigkeit

 - Unternehmerisches Denken und Handeln, Teamfähigkeit und das Streben nach Lösungen

 - Fließende Deutsch und sehr gute Englisch Kenntnisse (mündlich und schriftlich)

 - Sehr gute Präsentations-/ und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten

 - Verständnis für die Cybersicherheitslandschaft und die Fähigkeit, diese in Kunden-/Dienstleistungsmodelle zu integrieren

 - Bereitschaft zu einer Reisetätigkeit von bis zu 40 %.



Was wir bieten

 - Du wirst Teil eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Cyber Security-Start-ups in Europa

 - Du spielst eine Schlüsselrolle beim Aufbau einer innovativen Cyber Security Produktlinie, bei der wir effektive Cybersicherheit mit Cyberversicherungen auf globaler Ebene verbinden

 - Ein attraktives Vergütungspaket und Bonuszahlungen

 - Car Allowance und „flexible Urlaubstage" für zusätzliche Freizeit

 - MacBook oder Windows-Laptop sowie ein iPhone oder Android-Firmenhandy

 - Umfassende Unterstützung für deine persönliche und berufliche Entwicklung

 - Regelmäßige unternehmensweite Treffen, die dir die Möglichkeit bieten, persönlich zusammenzuarbeiten und starke Teambeziehungen aufzubauen



Über Eye

Eye Security ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Scale-ups Europas im Bereich Cyber Security und Cyber Insurance. Wir bauen unseren Markt in Österreich auf – und wir suchen dich, um das zu schaffen.

Mit über 180 Mitarbeitern europaweit und starkem Wachstum in der DACH-Region haben wir bewiesen, dass unsere Lösung funktioniert. Jetzt ist es an der Zeit, den österreichischen Mittelstand zu schützen.

Wir setzen neue Maßstäbe: Durch die Kombination von Spitzentechnologie und praktischem Fachwissen bieten wir dem europäischen Mittelstand Echtzeit-Schutz vor Cyberbedrohungen – auf dem neuesten Stand der Technik. Unser Team vereint Fachleute aus Geheimdiensten, Militär, Technologie und Beratung – alle getrieben von einer gemeinsamen Mission: Enterprise-Level-Cybersicherheit für jeden Mittelständler zugänglich zu machen, nicht nur für Großkonzerne.

Möchtest du dein Fachwissen für eine Herausforderung einsetzen, die wirklich etwas bewirkt? Wir freuen uns auf dich!

jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.description:
About Eye Security

Eye Security provides cybersecurity with embedded cyber insurance solutions for organizations in Europe. Our team brings together talent from intelligence, military, tech, and consulting backgrounds, all united by a shared mission: to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to every business, not just the big players.

Founded in The Hague in 2020, Eye Security combines managed detection and response, a 24/7 human-led SOC, rapid incident response and in-house cyber insurance on a single platform. The company serves organisations across the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany and is scaling its platform and go-to-market across Europe.

Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, J.P. Morgan Growth Equity Partners and TIN Capital, most recently raised a €60m Series C led by Sofina.



The Opportunity

As Eye Security grows, the Chief of Staff will support the leadership team in aligning priorities and translating strategy into coordinated action across the business. You will report directly to the CEO and work closely with the C-team, VPs and other senior leaders.

You will help turn company strategy into clear, coordinated execution. This includes bringing structure to leadership communication, planning, OKRs, performance reviews and cross-functional work, as well as coordinating complex strategic projects and ad hoc initiatives.



The Role

 - Connect strategy to execution. Build a detailed understanding of the company strategy, communicate its priorities clearly and work with VPs to translate them into plans for their teams.

 - Coordinate strategic projects and initiatives. Bring structure to complex, cross-functional work, clarify owners and next steps and keep delivery on track through to completion.

 - Strengthen the operating rhythm. Coordinate weekly and quarterly leadership routines, C-team and board meetings and follow up on decisions and actions. Build on processes that work well and improve those that need more structure.

 - Support effective OKRs. Work with the CEO and VPs to clarify objectives, owners, milestones, progress reviews and feedback loops. Make it easy to see what is on track and where action is needed.

 - Prepare performance reviews. Develop clear KPI reports and quarterly review materials that help leaders understand progress, gaps and next steps.

 - Surface issues and decisions. Identify roadblocks, delayed decisions and commitments at risk. Assess their impact, bring the right people together, and help find a practical way forward.

 - Keep leaders and stakeholders aligned. Build trusted working relationships across the business, communicate confidently with senior stakeholders, challenge constructively and maintain accountability while supporting collaboration.



Profile

 - Strong organisational and project management skills, with a track record of delivering complex, cross-functional work against clear milestones and timelines.

 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. You build trust and secure buy-in from senior leadership.

 - Ability to work credibly with a C-team and VP group while remaining approachable and adaptable.

 - Experience coordinating leadership processes, such as strategic planning, OKRs or performance reviews.

 - Confidence working with KPIs and business data, turning information into clear updates and actions.

 - A practical, structured approach. You follow through, keep stakeholders aligned and adapt plans when circumstances change.

 - A proactive, collaborative, delivery-focused mindset, with resilience and a strong sense of ownership.

 - Professional fluency in written and spoken English. Working proficiency in German or Dutch is an advantage.



Location

Berlin is our preferred location, though The Hague is also possible. You should be regularly present in the office and open to travelling between the two locations.
